claims: Spring generally occurs in March-May in the Northern Hemisphere.
Spring begins with the vernal equinox around March 20th.
Astronomical spring officially begins on the vernal equinox.
The vernal equinox is around March 20th or 21st.
On the vernal equinox, day and night are of roughly equal length.
Meteorological spring begins on March 1st for consistent tracking.
In the Northern Hemisphere, spring includes March, April, and May.
In the Southern Hemisphere, spring occurs from September to December.
The spring equinox has been recognized for centuries, according to MyNorthwest.com.
